lines.t: There’s a language beyond all knowing,
Where purest rivers are ever flowing,
A tongue not spoken by flesh or mind
But pure as the breath before the dawn
A language of light and beauty untold
A silence deeper than all sound
Where words dissolve into glory
And hearts in wonder are found
This is the language of the Eternal
The unspoken Word of God
Flowing as rivers of endless love
From the heart of the Almighty One
Pure and undefiled forever
In power and glory we stand
In union with the Spirit unbroken
Held within the Father’s hand
A mystery revealed to the faithful
A tongue of overwhelming love
Bringing forth wisdom and mercy
Descending from realms above
A song of radiant splendor
Where all creation bows low
The unseen truth of the heavens
That only the Spirit can know
This is the language of the Eternal
The unspoken Word of God
Flowing as rivers of endless love
From the heart of the Almighty One
Pure and undefiled forever
In power and glory we stand
In union with the Spirit unbroken
Held within the Father’s hand
Beyond time and beyond the stars
Beyond all that creation knows
The place where angels long to see
Where every secret flows
There He is and always has been
There you too shall be
In the bosom of the Father
One with eternity
This is the language of the Eternal
The Word beyond every tongue
Where all His servants shall gather
When every shadow is gone
Pure and undefiled forever
In power and glory we stand
In union with the Spirit unbroken
Held within the Father’s hand
A place without time or ending
The home of the Holy Lamb
The voice that needs no speaking
For He is The “I Am”
